none.note: The book names no king; 2 Kings 14:25 places Jonah son of Amittai in Jeroboam’s reign (see related).

related.quote: He restored the coast of Israel from the entering of Hamath unto the sea of the plain, according to the word of the LORD God of Israel, which he spake by the hand of his servant Jonah, the son of Amittai, the prophet, which was of Gath-hepher.
related.note: 2 Kings places Jonah son of Amittai in Jeroboam’s reign (“he” is Jeroboam son of Joash, 14:23); the book of Jonah names no king.
